newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran denies role in Saudi bombing last June.
newsitem.headline: Iran denies role in Saudi bombing last June.

text.p: Iran reiterated its rejection of media reports that it was linked to the bombing of a U.S. military housing complex in Saudi Arabia and said it did not fear threats from any country.

Asked about U.S. media allegations linking Iran to the June 25 bombing which killed 19 U.S. airmen, Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati said on Sunday night that Iran "categorically rejects the charges no matter who raises them".
"There are countries in the world which do not have good intentions towards Iran...They intend to accuse Iran in a bid to secure their illegitimate interests (in the region)," he said.
The official news agency IRNA said Velayati was speaking on the sidelines of a seminar on the development and security of the Gulf region, which sits on more than half the world's oil reserves.

"Tehran does not fear the threats of any country, no matter how powerful it may be," Velayati said in reference to the media reports that Washington was preparing to attack Iran if proved involved in the bombing in the eastern Saudi town of Khobar.

The U.S. administration has said it had not yet concluded who was responsible for the bombing, but Iran's spiritual leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has said the U.S. media reports indicated Washington was preparing to attack Iran.

Saudi Arabia has said the U.S. media reports were unreliable and added that it would announce the results of the probe into the bombing without delay. It did not mention Iran, but said it was seeking the truth and would not use the investigation to settle accounts with other countries.
Velayati earlier told the seminar that only the withdrawal of U.S. and other Western troops patrolling the Gulf from the region would guarantee its security and stability.

"The withdrawal of foreign forces from the Persian Gulf can be regarded as a sign of respect for the independence and sovereignty of regional countries...Once the people in the region get rid of the foreign forces and culture, they will have a peaceful and stable region," he added.
